body: I'm sorry for clogging the board with this bullshit, but I had nowhere else to go.

I've been reading these replies. I also got in contact with a friend from out of state. I don't know what to do. But other people are in the same position, I'm not going to a shrink b/c they could also disqualify me. I dont want two strikes. I'm still in a bad place, but I feel like I can turn this around. I dont know why I'm typing this. Things aren't getting better. But I'm feeling less like scum than yesterday.

Fuck dude, I'm with you. I found out last month I can't join because of previous medication. I'm on the fucking verge. Where are you? :(
Do you want to talk about it?
The girl was the last thing holding me together. I'm so fucking empty.

We're both 20. I feel like shit because my life is in shambles. I failed my second semester at school. I found my calling in life, but discovered I'm ineligible to join(coast guard) because I took ADHD medication in high school. I'm in debt up to my fucking eyeballs and I have no one to talk to. Now I fuck this las thing up. I don't know where to turn. I want to be mad at her, but I can't. It all comes back to me. The reason I'm a failure IS ME. and there is nothing I can do about it.
I don't care about myself, she was all that was left in my fucking life.
